customer_name: China Mars Exploration Project (中国火星探测工程)
business_problem: The Mars exploration program wanted a more vivid, interactive way to popularize aerospace science and engage the public, rather than relying only on static exhibits or one-way explanations.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and the China Mars Exploration Project created the world's first digital-human version of a Mars rover, Zhurong, to turn aerospace outreach into a real-time interactive experience. The system combines four-dimensional scanning, high-precision 3D avatar creation, and repeated machine-learning-driven tuning so the digital character can move, emote, and respond naturally. A lightweight deep neural network predicts expressions and lip movements end to end in real time, while the rendering pipeline keeps latency low enough for stage interaction. Baidu also exposes multiple driving modes — text, voice, ordinary RGB camera input, and depth-camera face capture — so the same digital-human technology can work in a range of presentation environments. Underneath, multimodal AI, NLP, and speech recognition make the character capable of fluent conversational interaction and multilingual expression. The result is a digital-outreach platform that makes space science more accessible and provides a reusable template for immersive public education content.

solution_components.name: Zhurong Digital Human
solution_components.role: Delivers the interactive public-facing Mars-rover persona used for real-time science communication and education events.

solution_components.name: 4D Scanning Technology
solution_components.role: Captures high-precision training data that is used to build and iteratively tune the digital human's 3D appearance, expressions, and motion.

data_flow: High-precision scan data is converted into a 3D digital-human model, neural-network inference predicts expressions and lip sync in real time, multimodal input from text, voice, or camera drivers controls the interaction, and the rendered character returns live responses to audiences in outreach settings.
business_outcome: The program created a memorable, immersive science-popularization experience that makes aerospace exploration easier to understand and more appealing to younger audiences.
metrics: expression and lip-sync prediction accuracy exceeded 98.5%
architecture_clues: The digital human supports four driving modes rather than a single animation path.
A lightweight neural network is used so expression and lip movement can be predicted in real time with low latency.
The same digital-human platform is positioned as reusable across media, finance, e-commerce, healthcare, and other industries.
evidence_quotes: Baidu AI Cloud and the China Mars Exploration Project jointly created the world's first Mars-rover digital human. (original: 百度智能云与中国火星探测工程联合打造全球首个火星车数字人"祝融号"。)

The digital human uses domestic first-in-class 4D scanning plus cinematic-grade 3D avatar technology to make its texture, expressions, and movements natural and vivid. (original: 百度智能云采用国内首创的 4D 扫描技术...基于百度智能云的影视级高精拟真 3D 人像制作技术、拟人化 3D 卡通形象制作技术，数字人的质感、表情、动作，都有着真实、生动、自然的表现。)
Its lightweight deep neural network can predict expressions and lip movements end to end in real time with accuracy above 98.5%. (original: 火星车数字人采用了轻量级的深度神经网络模型，能够实现端到端的表情和口型实时预测，准确率高于98.5%。)
The platform supports text, voice, ordinary RGB camera, and depth-camera driving modes. (original: 百度的数字人技术拥有文本驱动、语音驱动、普通 RGB 摄像头面部驱动、深度摄像头面部采集驱动共四种驱动方式。)

The digital human is meant to bring aerospace closer to ordinary people and inspire more young people to pay attention to China's space exploration achievements. (original: 可爱的火星车数字人将拉近航天和普通人的距离，激发大众对航天的热情，使更多年轻人关注到中国的航天探索成果。)
